notes:
Summary: Started strong — clear production use case (chat + search + reranking), strict residency requirements, and a compliance-heavy checklist. POC delivered acceptable perf but procurement timeline and existing enterprise AWS discounts won the decision.

Key excerpts: - 'We have an org-wide mandate to consolidate on AWS for platform services' (VP Eng). - 'Security would prefer managed endpoints inside our existing cloud contracts to reduce procurement friction' (Head of Security).

Why we lost: 1) Hyperscaler consolidation: Cedarcrest already has enterprise AWS discounts and preferred-vendor clauses; SageMaker endpoints met 'good enough' bar and procurement cycle was faster. 2) Procurement speed: legal and procurement prioritized fewer vendors. 3) No internal champion after right-sizing — initial sponsor (Dir of Platform) moved teams mid-POC. 4) Budget headcount freeze for new vendor onboarding.

What worked: Technical team liked runtime performance and observability demos. SE (Daniel) established trust; POC metrics captured.

Action items / next steps: - Document procurement objections and template responses for hyperscaler consolidation scenarios. - Request demo of integrated billing and contract transition flows to add to playbook. - Schedule win-back outreach Sep 2025 (6 months) after expected budget cycle.

Artifacts: pricing deck + security FAQ in Drive. Jira INF-4271 tracked a KMS/role issue during POC. Gmail thread contains legal RFP draft.
final_outcome: closed-lost to aws-sagemaker-endpoints due to enterprise AWS consolidation and faster procurement
